info.title: API.SH: IAAI
info.description: The IAAI API from API.SH: public IAAI data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
IAAI's auctions for one day: each auction's id, branch, city, state, market, date and time, pre-bid close, status, public/online flags, regional sale name, lane count, vehicle count, Run & Drive and Buy Now counts, vehicles remaining, announcement and every lane with its vehicle counts. `available_dates` lists the coming auction days with their auction counts. Filter by keyword, market, public auctions and distance from a ZIP.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/iaai-auctions

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Auction day (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC); default today.

parameters.name: days_ahead
parameters.description: Instead of `date`: today plus this many days (0-60).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keyword (branch, city).

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: Market (default `us`).

parameters.name: public_only
parameters.description: `true`: only auctions open to the public.

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: US ZIP or Canadian postal code: only auctions within `miles` of it.

parameters.name: miles
parameters.description: Distance from `zip` in miles (default 250).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Vehicles for sale at IAAI (Insurance Auto Auctions) with every filter of the site's search: keywords, make, model, series, year and odometer range, vehicle type and subtype, start code (Run & Drive, Starts, Stationary), fuel, cylinders, engine size, transmission, drive, airbags, primary damage, loss type, key, body style, country of origin, colours, auction type (live, timed, Buy Now), featured auctions, Buy Now price band, state, branch, title/sale document, who can buy, region, market, availability, auction day and ZIP distance, with the site's sorts. Each vehicle: item id, stock number, title, year, make, model, series, masked VIN, title/sale document, primary and secondary damage, loss type, vehicle type, odometer, start code, airbags, key, colours, engine, fuel, cylinders, transmission, drive, body style, country of origin, actual cash value, branch, market, region, lane/run, auction date, sale list link, image and link. `facets=true` adds every filter's values with counts. 25, 50 or 100 per page; `total` is the site's count. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. Bids, full VINs and seller names need a buyer account and are not included.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/iaai-search

get.description:
One IAAI vehicle by item id or link: year, make, model, series, masked VIN, type, class, body, engine, displacement, cylinders, fuel, transmission, drive, colours, country of origin, odometer and its brand, primary and secondary damage, loss type, start code, run & drive, airbags, keys, catalytic converter, vehicle grade, title/sale document, title state and brand, actual cash value, estimated repair cost, origin, who can buy, Buy Now price, bid increment, auction date, pre-bid close, lane, item, aisle and stall, branch and pickup location (address, phone, coordinates), the vehicle information, description and sale information tables as the page shows them, and every photo. `latest=true` returns the next vehicle up for auction. A vehicle answers 404 once it is sold or removed.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/iaai-vehicle

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An iaai.com/VehicleDetail/<id> link.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: `true`: the next vehicle up for auction (when no id is given).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
